labelReview: Assistant-authored and assistant-reviewed synthetic references; independent user or instructor review remains pending.
evaluationDesign: The original 20 cases are a regression split. Forty new cases were frozen before retesting the same four prompt texts; no prompt is tuned on the new-case outputs.
urgencyPolicy: Explicit HIGH/LOW/MEDIUM wording takes precedence, with negation respected. Otherwise compare the work-request sentAt calendar date to an explicit deadline: 0–7 days HIGH, 8–30 MEDIUM, >30 LOW; neither cue means null.
